headline: Names a post office in Brockport, New York, after Staff Sergeant Nicholas J. Reid.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service building at 14 Main Street in Brockport, New York, as the "Staff Sergeant Nicholas J. Reid Post Office Building." It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its hours.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on June 9, 2014, when it was signed.
